name: application-avatar-uploader
title: Avatar Uploader
description: Circular avatar drop-zone with a hover camera overlay, a live preview from a real file input, and Replace/Remove actions.
useWhen: Letting a user set or change their profile photo on an account or settings page.
The upload target is a single circular image with an obvious 1:1 crop expectation, not an arbitrary file.
You want the whole avatar to be the click target rather than a separate small upload button.
avoidWhen: Users need to upload multiple files or non-image files — use `file-uploaders` for that general-purpose case instead.
The avatar isn't user-editable (e.g. viewing someone else's profile) — a plain `avatar` display is correct without upload affordances.
You need cropping/zooming before saving — pair this with an `image-cropper` step rather than accepting the raw file as-is.
responsiveBehavior: Fixed circular size that does not need to reflow; center it within its container at any viewport width.
accessibility: The entire avatar circle is a <label> wrapping a real file input, so it is reachable and operable via keyboard, not just a decorative click target.
The camera overlay icon is aria-hidden since the label's accessible name already communicates the upload action.
The hidden native file input is visually hidden with sr-only, not display:none, so it remains in the accessibility tree and focusable.
Replace/Remove are separate, clearly labeled text actions rather than being bundled into one ambiguous control.

variants.title: Avatar Uploader
variants.description: Circular photo preview with a hover camera overlay and Replace/Remove actions below.
accessibility: Selecting a file updates a real object-URL preview and reveals the Remove action, rather than being a static mockup.

variants.title: Avatar Uploader (Dark)
variants.description: Avatar uploader adapted for dark surfaces.
